rows.label: 15 LatexGen items, greedy, fresh page per bucket
rows.statistic: median over the 15 LatexGen items of one greedy pass each (encoder + decode to eos); the harness uses a fresh page per length bucket. Isolated encoder/decode numbers are 5 warmup + 5 timed runs.

latexgenOrtWebgpuInt4.runtime: ONNX Runtime Web WebGPU EP, int4, as LatexGen ships (docs/benchmarks.md)

latexgenOrtCpuInt8.runtime: ONNX Runtime Web WASM/CPU, int8, as LatexGen ships

floor.reasoning: Decode is a one-row matmul per step against ~285 MiB of fp16 constants. Encoder is ~5 ms independent of bucket. The long tail is token count (circle-area 12 tokens / 47 ms, analysis-classics 89 tokens / 410 ms).

history.label: pass one (rel-bias gather on the wrong axis)

caveat: Absolute numbers move with machine load. The 146.2 ms median was noisier than an earlier 124.4 ms run of the same graph (analysis-classics 312 → 410 ms). Interleaved deltas were not taken; the headline is this JSON.
